specification.title: Wireframe And Isocurve Pass
specification.goal: draw curves, edges and NURBS isocurves
specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.
specification.parent_scope: GPU viewport wireframe/shaded, gem display, camera draw, overlays và mesh tessellation.
specification.parent_exclusions: Không bao gồm offline render/V-Ray studio.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Wireframe And Isocurve Pass” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: geometry fixture checks BRep validity/tolerance/closedness or documented intentional open output.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M01: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Wireframe And Isocurve Pass”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

execution_design.implementation_owner_policy: One owning L2, UI modules dispatch only. No source code changes in vendor-research/ unless approved fork.
objectives: Define typed seam + explicitly testable oracle
Implement one capability at its canonical owner
Verify failure rollback, stable IDs/units/geometry as relevant

round_top_and_palette_2026_11_22.scope: Round-brilliant topology strokes and trimmed one-pixel isocurves, with a black Wireframe background. The Windows Top comparison covers 93.0% of reference wire pixels at a three-pixel tolerance.

camera_relative_strokes_2026_11_22.scope: Model-wire width and intensity, camera-relative depth, selected and unselected Windows viewport captures. Existing shared line buffers serve Wireframe and Shaded.
camera_relative_strokes_2026_11_22.remaining: Human comparison with Rhino 5 and Matrix9 reference images.

wire_owner_source_lifetime_2026_11_14.scope: Wire owners no longer retain a temporary BRep source candidate; they conservatively reserve topology for surviving display pins.
wire_owner_source_lifetime_2026_11_14.remaining: Exact charge de-duplication, buffer and source lifetimes, memory pressure and runtime behavior remain unverified.

extract_source_wires_2026_11_14.scope: Synchronous, worker and multi-occurrence OCCT ExtractWireframe request default source wires even when the prior scene lacks a wire receipt.
extract_source_wires_2026_11_14.remaining: Native face binding, remaining scene paths and runtime geometry and invocation behavior remain unverified.

nested_wire_reuse_admission_2026_11_14.scope: Edit preflight tracks full nested occurrence paths and plans reuse with the same source and display checks as capture.
nested_wire_reuse_admission_2026_11_14.remaining: Nested mixed-reuse budgets, account ownership, rollback and runtime behavior remain unverified.

root_wire_reuse_admission_2026_11_14.scope: Edit capture validates the prior scene account and plans eligible root wire reuse without a second ordinary buffer.
root_wire_reuse_admission_2026_11_14.remaining: Nested planning, cross-account behavior, memory ownership and runtime validation remain open.

edit_capture_wire_reuse_2026_11_14.scope: Full edit capture reuses eligible prior source-bound wire buffers before ordinary buffer construction.
edit_capture_wire_reuse_2026_11_14.remaining: Conservative admission, transform and instance behavior, memory ownership and runtime validation remain open.

edit_wire_reuse_2026_11_14.scope: Full edit scenes reuse prior local wire buffers for matching occurrence, source identity and pinned display allocation.
edit_wire_reuse_2026_11_14.remaining: Ordinary candidate capture still constructs buffers; transforms, ownership and runtime behavior remain unverified.

source_wire_profile_2026_11_14.scope: Source-wire scene replacements retain the stored certified display profile and mark unspecified profiles unknown.
source_wire_profile_2026_11_14.remaining: Runtime profile behavior, durable topology binding and remaining scene paths are unverified.

interior_wire_receipt_2026_11_14.scope: Immutable scene buffers record completed source interior-wire preparation even when it produces no segments, while preserving display-prefix validation.
interior_wire_receipt_2026_11_14.remaining: Other publication paths, native payloads, durable topology binding and runtime validation remain open.

edit_candidate_wires_2026_11_14.scope: Incremental and full edit candidates prepare missing OCCT source wires before commit; full scene capture uses the coordinator representation store.
edit_candidate_wires_2026_11_14.remaining: Other publication paths, native payloads, durable topology binding and runtime validation remain open; edit wire preparation currently runs synchronously.

open_candidate_wires_2026_11_14.scope: The Open worker prepares source-derived interior wires for private OCCT scene occurrences before publication.
open_candidate_wires_2026_11_14.remaining: Other scene paths, legacy compatibility, native payloads, durable topology binding and runtime validation remain open.

history_retained_wires_2026_11_14.scope: History worker prepares source-derived interior wires for retained as well as rebuilt OCCT representations, including nested occurrences; direct Undo and Redo wait for the same worker.
history_retained_wires_2026_11_14.remaining: Other scene paths, native payloads, durable topology binding and runtime validation remain open.

occurrence_wire_extraction_2026_11_14.scope: ExtractWireframe checks published OCCT buffers using the full instance path; unverified native face/trim extraction explicitly refuses before the output transaction.
occurrence_wire_extraction_2026_11_14.remaining: Native face support, complete I1 integration and runtime validation remain open.

history_rebuild_wires_2026_11_14.scope: The OCCT history cache-miss worker prepares source-derived interior wire buffers for roots and nested occurrences sharing an exact previously attested source allocation.
history_rebuild_wires_2026_11_14.remaining: Runtime and geometry verification, independent block and legacy attestation, shared occurrence buffers, native payloads and other scene paths remain open.

runtime_implementation.scope: Untrimmed standalone NURBS surfaces publish default-density knot or midpoint wires in the scene; ExtractWireframe uses the same parameters.
runtime_implementation.remaining: Desktop appearance, non-default density and trimmed-surface isocurves are not established.

brep_worker_checkpoint.scope: Explicit attested root remesh with a display reservation publishes source-derived interior wires as render-only segments; Box source samples, two deflections, edge-pick exclusion, history and budget refusal checked.
brep_worker_checkpoint.remaining: Ordinary scene, broad trims and density, GPU/desktop, and source/display ownership separation remain open; later checkpoints cover scoped ExtractWireframe and NativeBrep fixtures.

dupedge_source_view_checkpoint.scope: DupEdge temporary OCCT and NativeBrep box views prepare source-derived face wires; checks cover topology edge picking, cancel and buffer refusal.
dupedge_source_view_checkpoint.remaining: Other native shapes, arbitrary trim, density and desktop rendering remain unverified; failure to generate source wires refuses the temporary view.
